entities.name: Garden of Apeiron
entities.description: A vast uncharted, dangerous region of the Sothera system, a ship graveyard that appears to be moving toward Sothera.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Star system of the Edge; its star strayed into aether and collapsed.

entities.name: Edge
entities.description: The region of space containing the Sothera system.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: Boundary of the Garden's present region of space.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: Body whose orbital path bounds the Garden's present region.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: Inhabitants of the Sothera system who named the Garden.

entities.name: Endstone

events.summary: Sothera's star strays into a cloud of interstellar aether, grows into a red giant, ruptures its bounds and collapses; the cloud later becomes known as the Garden.
events.quote: the star strayed into a cloud of interstellar aether

events.summary: Around 4564 AR Sami, Tannuk, Alpharael, Haliya and Tezzeret pass through the Garden to bring the Endstone to the Vaar.
events.quote: passed through the Garden to bring the Endstone to its creators

relations.note: The Vaar are the Endstone's creators.
relations.quote: the Endstone to its creators, the Vaar

relations.note: A region in the Sothera system.
relations.quote: in the Sothera system of the Edge
